metrics_finding.finding: inventory-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization remained stable.

evidence_summary.summary: Inventory service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization remained stable.

report.suggested_fix: Check inventory service CPU resource allocation and adjust as needed.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the inventory service. Further investigation is required to confirm this finding.
report_text.hi: संकट के पीछे का मुख्य कारण स्टोरेज सेवा होने की संभावना है। अतिरिक्त जांच आवश्यक है ताकि यह पता लगाया जा सके कि यह खोज कितनी विश्वसनीय है।
